assay: total RNA-seq (Ribo-Zero), human vastus lateralis biopsies (S2.4.p1)
subjects: 8 young sedentary Caucasian males, biopsy before and after 6 weeks of endurance training (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1)
sample_inclusion: 16 biopsies; P6_2 and P8_2 excluded from DE for dermis contamination (S2.4.p1)
primary_estimand: within-participant change in skeletal muscle gene expression after 6 weeks endurance training (trained vs untrained), paired by participant
planned_contrasts: trained vs untrained, ~participant + training (S2.4.p1; S3.1.p2: 641 up, 176 down, FDR<0.1, of 13,108 detected genes)
normalization: kallisto v0.46 transcript quantification, summed to genes by sleuth (S2.4.p1)
paper_method: sleuth v0.30 likelihood ratio test ~participant vs ~participant + training; fold changes from Wald test (S2.4.p1)
